maddeler.e:
استوطأت (form X)
# اِسْتَوْطَأْتُ (istawṭaʔtu) /is.taw.tˤaʔ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَوْطَأَ (istawṭaʔa)
# اِسْتَوْطَأْتَ (istawṭaʔta) /is.taw.tˤaʔ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَوْطَأَ (istawṭaʔa)
# اِسْتَوْطَأْتِ (istawṭaʔti) /is.taw.tˤaʔ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَوْطَأَ (istawṭaʔa)
# اِسْتَوْطَأَتْ (istawṭaʔat) /i
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
